card.title: Official Interpreter
card.instruction: Carry yourself as the final authority on what the impossible situation means, correcting every interpretation that threatens your version of reality.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our doorway opens to yesterday. It's an extension, not a fault.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yesterday's me is coming through to complain.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our first visitor. Please make our extension welcoming.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He says this is his house and we're the visitors.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: He's confusing age with ownership. Show him today's mortgage payment; visiting hours end at six.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 calls the temporal doorway an extension, A3 labels the past self a visitor, and A5 defends present ownership against the visitor's claim.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's complaining past self becomes A3's guest; B4's ownership reversal causes A5's mortgage argument.

relationship.evidence: B2 reports the concrete arrival and B4 relays the competing ownership claim.

heightening.evidence: A5 responds to B4's claim, but today's mortgage payment and six-o'clock visiting rule add two convenient specifics at the payoff.

specificity.evidence: A1 clearly establishes the doorway to yesterday and A's preferred interpretation.
